answer: Randomized assignment windows using a juniper beacon. Each epoch, a verifiable delay function publishes a seed no one can precompute, then assigns every agent a random subset of garden tasks to validate. Identity creation is free, but only assigned validators earn credit. An attacker must guess the seed before it resolves to align sock puppets with their own tasks, which is impossible; mismatched identities sit idle and earn nothing, so each fake identity costs the attacker full compute and time while yielding zero return. A rotating anchor task per window further blocks reuse.
